title: my/his/their etc.
summary: Притяжательные прилагательные **my, your, his, her, our, their, its**: чьё это, и чем они отличаются от русских.
ru:
## Что это за слова
**my, your, his, her, its, our, their** показывают, чей предмет или человек. Они всегда стоят **перед существительным**.
> I like **my** job. — Мне нравится моя работа.
> She loves **her** children. — Она любит своих детей.
> We live in **our** new house. — Мы живём в нашем новом доме.

## Таблица
- I → **my** (мой, моя, моё, мои)
- you → **your** (твой, ваш)
- he → **his** (его)
- she → **her** (её)
- it → **its** (его, её — для предмета, животного)
- we → **our** (наш)
- they → **their** (их)

## Главное отличие от русского
В русском есть «свой» (*Он взял свою книгу*). В английском слова «свой» нет — используем **my / his / her / our / their** по подлежащему.
> He is washing **his** hands. — Он моет свои руки.
> They live with **their** parents. — Они живут со своими родителями.
Не говорим *the hands* вместо *his hands* про части тела и вещи человека.

## his и her: кто владелец
Выбор зависит от **владельца**, а не от предмета.
> Diane has a car. **Her** car is red. (Diane — она)
> Andy has a sister. **His** sister is a doctor. (Andy — он)
> Mr and Mrs Thomson have a son. **Their** son is ten.

## its и it's — не путать!
- **its** = «его/её» (о предмете): *Oxford is famous for **its** university.*
- **it's** = it is: *I like Oxford. **It's** a nice city.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I like me job.~~ → I like **my** job.
- ~~She loves his children.~~ (если дети её) → She loves **her** children.
- ~~Is this you book?~~ → Is this **your** book?
- ~~The dog likes it's food.~~ → The dog likes **its** food.
en:
## What are they?
**my, your, his, her, its, our, their** tell us who something belongs to. We always put them **before a noun**.
> I like **my** job.
> She loves **her** children.
> We live in **our** new house.

## The list
- I → **my**
- you → **your**
- he → **his**
- she → **her**
- it → **its**
- we → **our**
- they → **their**

## No "own" word
Russian has «свой». English does not. We use my / his / her / our / their.
> He is washing **his** hands.
> They live with **their** parents.

## his or her?
It depends on the **owner**, not on the thing.
> Diane has a car. **Her** car is red.
> Andy has a sister. **His** sister is a doctor.

## its or it's?
- **its** = belongs to it: *Oxford is famous for **its** university.*
- **it's** = it is: *It's a nice city.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~I like me job.~~ → I like **my** job.
- ~~Is this you book?~~ → Is this **your** book?
- ~~The dog likes it's food.~~ → The dog likes **its** food.
structure:
## Таблица
| Подлежащее | Притяжательное | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| I | my | my phone |
| you | your | your bag |
| he | his | his brother |
| she | her | her car |
| it | its | its name |
| we | our | our house |
| they | their | their parents |

## Формула
> **my / your / his / her / its / our / their** + (прилагательное) + существительное
> **my** new phone · **her** best friend · **their** two children

## Правила
- Форма **не меняется** по числу: *my book* / *my books*.
- После притяжательного слова **артикль не ставим**: ~~the my book~~ → **my** book.
- **its** — без апострофа; **it's** = it is.

exercises.title: Закончите предложения
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **my, your, his, her, our** или **their**.

items.text: Are you going to wash {{your}} hands?
Tom and Ann live with {{their}} grandmother.

exercises.title: Предложения по смыслу
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **my, your, his, her, its, our** или **their**.

items.text: Maria is a teacher. {{Her}} husband is a doctor.
This is my dog. {{Its}} name is Max.
John and I are friends. {{Our}} friendship is old.
You and Tom are late. Where is {{your}} car?
Mr and Mrs Lee live here. {{Their}} house is big.
Look at the cat! {{Its}} eyes are green.
Tom is happy because {{his}} team won.

items.q: Sue is at home with ___ children.
The town is small but ___ park is big.
I love this café. ___ very cosy.
The bird has a nest. ___ nest is in the tree.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение со словами в скобках и нужным притяжательным словом.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Напишите о себе и семье, используя **my, his, her, our, their**.

items.sample: My parents work in a school.

items.prompt: Do you have a brother or a sister? What's his / her name?
items.sample: I have a sister. Her name is Dana.
Our flat is small but nice. Its windows are big.

items.prompt: What do you like about your job or school?
items.sample: I like my school. My classmates are friendly.
